post.description:
Country-year observations for up to 10 indicator codes (from `indicators`), parsed live from the official Excel files: value as source text (null for blank/suppressed cells with the reason in series_note), unit copied from the file, SDMX flag and label, provisional marker, country as ISO3 + M49 + label, file edition and publication date. Filter by ISO3 `countries`, `year_from`/`year_to` and, for arrivals-by-region, `partner` (total | all | UN Tourism region code). Cursor-paginated, deterministic order.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes. Omit or empty for every reporter (countries, territories and, in the SDG files, regional aggregates).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query.

indicator_codes.description: Indicator codes such as INBD_TRIP_TOTL_TOTL_TOUR (international tourist arrivals, overnight). Legacy Compendium codes such as CP_1_2 are accepted when a free equivalent exists. Codes spanning more than 3 source files are rejected.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

partner.description: Arrivals-by-region only: "total" (default: World / no partner dimension), "all" for every region of origin, or a UN Tourism region code (10000 Africa, 20000 Americas, 30000 East Asia and the Pacific, 40000 Europe, 50000 Middle East, 60000 South Asia, 70000 Other not classified).

post.description:
The official UN Tourism Key Tourism Statistics Excel files (13 files: inbound arrivals/expenditure/by region/by purpose/by transport/accommodation, outbound departures/expenditure, domestic trips/accommodation, hotel capacity and occupancy, employment SDG 8.9.2, tourism GDP SDG 8.9.1). One live HEAD per file returns Last-Modified as source_updated_at, ETag and S3 version id, and changed_since_catalog flags a re-publication since the embedded catalogue.

post.description:
Search the 148 free indicators (code, name, series group, unit, source file). `query` matches words in the code, name, previous Compendium code, unit, file id or common synonyms (receipts -> inbound expenditure, occupancy -> hotel room/bed rates); `series_group` narrows to inbound, outbound, domestic, industries, employment or macro. Cursor-paginated; each page carries the live publication date of its source files.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

page_size

query.description: Free-text filter: every word must appear in the code, name, legacy code, unit, file id or a built-in synonym (receipts, occupancy, region of origin, mode of transport, departures, nights, employment, tourism gdp); empty lists every indicator.
